_comment: Unused-dependency check of the shared kit (scripts/_abhaengigkeiten.py, kit 0.73.0), run by the audit workflow. deploy/gateway/requirements.in is no app manifest of its own: it is the one input of the gateway image's hashed lock list, it repeats the dependencies + extra gateway of pyproject.toml (tests/test_repo.py keeps both equal), and the image installs it with --no-deps before TinySesam itself. The packages are imported by tinysesam, not by the image's own setup script.

deploy/gateway/requirements.in.fastapi: lock-list input of the gateway image: TinySesam's own dependency, installed --no-deps before the package
deploy/gateway/requirements.in.starlette: lock-list input of the gateway image: TinySesam's own dependency, installed --no-deps before the package

deploy/gateway/requirements.in.pyotp: lock-list input of the gateway image: TinySesam's own dependency, installed --no-deps before the package
deploy/gateway/requirements.in.httpx: lock-list input of the gateway image: extra gateway of TinySesam, installed --no-deps before the package
